resteasy_overlay_workflow.overview: Liberty does not contain the entire RESTEasy codebase, only files that need to be overridden to make Liberty-specific changes. These are called "overlay files". This workflow guides you through pulling in new overlay files from the RESTEasy upstream repository.

concept.name: overlay_files
concept.description: Files copied from RESTEasy upstream that Liberty needs to modify for integration. These files maintain a reference to their source commit for tracking purposes.

concept.name: version_tracking
concept.description: Each bundle's bnd.bnd file contains a resteasy-version property (e.g., resteasy-version=4.7.2.Final) that indicates which RESTEasy release the bundle is based on.

concept.name: source_attribution
concept.description: Each overlay file should include a comment linking to the specific commit version of the file in the RESTEasy repository.

step.title: Identify RESTEasy Version
step.description: Determine which version of RESTEasy the bundle uses by examining its bnd.bnd file.

actions.action: Note the version for use in subsequent steps

step.title: Identify File to Overlay
step.description: Determine the exact file path in the RESTEasy repository that needs to be overlaid.

mapping_rules.rule: Determine which RESTEasy module contains the file

step.title: Find Latest Commit for the File
step.description: Locate the specific commit hash for the file in the RESTEasy release tag.

instructions.instruction: Navigate to the RESTEasy GitHub repository
Switch to the tag matching the version
Navigate to the file location in the appropriate module
Get the permalink with commit hash

step.title: Create Package Directory if Needed
step.description: Ensure the package directory structure exists in the Liberty bundle.

actions.action: Check if the package directory exists
Create the full directory path if needed

step.title: Fetch File Content from GitHub
step.description: Retrieve the raw content of the file from the RESTEasy repository using execute_command with curl.

actions.action: Convert the GitHub blob URL to a raw content URL by replacing 'blob' with 'raw.githubusercontent.com'
Use execute_command with curl to fetch the content
Store the fetched content for the next step

step.note: The -s flag makes curl silent (no progress bar). The output will be the file content.

step.title: Create File with Source Attribution
step.description: Create the overlay file with proper copyright header and source attribution using write_to_file.

file_structure.line: Source attribution comment with GitHub permalink
Original file content from RESTEasy (from step 5)

step.implementation: Combine the copyright header, source attribution, and fetched content into a single file. Use write_to_file tool to create the file in the correct location.
step.example:
<write_to_file> <path>io.openliberty.org.jboss.resteasy.common/src/org/jboss/resteasy/spi/util/NewFile.java</path> <content> /******************************************************************************* * Copyright (c) 2026 IBM Corporation and others. * All rights reserved. This program and the accompanying materials * are made available under the terms of the Eclipse Public License 2.0 * which accompanies this distribution, and is available at * http://www.eclipse.org/legal/epl-2.0/ * * SPDX-License-Identifier: EPL-2.0 *******************************************************************************/ // Source: https://github.com/resteasy/resteasy/blob/abc123def456/resteasy-core-spi/src/main/java/org/jboss/resteasy/spi/util/NewFile.java package org.jboss.resteasy.spi.util;
[... content fetched from GitHub in step 5 ...] </content> <line_count>150</line_count> </write_to_file>

step.title: Verify the Overlay File
step.description: Confirm the file was created correctly.

verification_checklist.item: Source attribution comment includes full GitHub permalink

liberty_change_markers.overview: All Liberty-specific modifications to overlay files MUST be marked with standard Liberty Change comments. This is critical for tracking differences from upstream RESTEasy code.

single_line.example: private ClassLoader classLoader = getLibertyClassLoader(); // Liberty Change

when_to_mark.scenario: Adding new code not in upstream RESTEasy
Modifying existing RESTEasy code for Liberty compatibility
Removing or commenting out RESTEasy code
Changing method signatures or return types

benefits.benefit: Easy identification of Liberty changes when updating to newer RESTEasy versions
Clear understanding of what needs to be preserved during updates
Ability to generate diffs showing only Liberty modifications

best_practices.practice: Always use the full commit hash in source attribution
Verify the correct RESTEasy module for the file
Mark all Liberty-specific modifications with Liberty Change comments
Preserve any Liberty-specific modifications when updating
Document why the overlay is needed and why changes were made

complete_example.title: Complete Example: Adding FindAnnotation.java to io.openliberty.org.jboss.resteasy.common
complete_example.scenario: User wants to add org.jboss.resteasy.spi.util.FindAnnotation.java as an overlay file

step.description: Read bnd.bnd to get RESTEasy version
Identify the file location in RESTEasy
step.analysis: Package: org.jboss.resteasy.spi.util Module: resteasy-core-spi (based on package prefix) Path: resteasy-core-spi/src/main/java/org/jboss/resteasy/spi/util/FindAnnotation.java

step.description: Navigate to GitHub and get commit hash
step.instructions: 1. Go to https://github.com/resteasy/resteasy 2. Switch to tag 4.7.2.Final 3. Navigate to resteasy-core-spi/src/main/java/org/jboss/resteasy/spi/util/FindAnnotation.java 4. Click the file to view it 5. Copy the permalink URL (contains commit hash) Example result: https://github.com/resteasy/resteasy/blob/a1b2c3d4e5f6.../resteasy-core-spi/src/main/java/org/jboss/resteasy/spi/util/FindAnnotation.java

step.description: Fetch the file content from GitHub
step.note: Store the output content for the next step

step.description: Create the overlay file with headers and content
step.tool_use:
<write_to_file> <path>io.openliberty.org.jboss.resteasy.common/src/org/jboss/resteasy/spi/util/FindAnnotation.java</path> <content> /******************************************************************************* * Copyright (c) 2026 IBM Corporation and others. * All rights reserved. This program and the accompanying materials * are made available under the terms of the Eclipse Public License 2.0 * which accompanies this distribution, and is available at * http://www.eclipse.org/legal/epl-2.0/ * * SPDX-License-Identifier: EPL-2.0 *******************************************************************************/ // Source: https://github.com/resteasy/resteasy/blob/a1b2c3d4e5f6/resteasy-core-spi/src/main/java/org/jboss/resteasy/spi/util/FindAnnotation.java package org.jboss.resteasy.spi.util;
[... paste the content fetched from curl in step 5 ...] </content> <line_count>120</line_count> </write_to_file>

step.description: Verify the file was created correctly
step.verification: - Copyright header present - Source attribution comment with full GitHub URL - Package declaration matches directory structure
